name: Mini Mushroom & Olive English Muffin Pizzas

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and roughly chop mushrooms into small pieces. Place in a small bowl.
Drain olives and add to the bowl with the mushrooms. Stir to combine the toppings and set aside.
Place tomato sauce and spices in another small bowl. Stir to combine the pizza sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (8 fl oz) can tomato sauce
2 tsp Italian seasoning
1 tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
⅛ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Split muffins in half. Arrange on a large baking sheet pan, split-side down.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping once, until muffins are lightly toasted, about 3 minutes. Remove from oven.
To assemble the pizzas, spread each muffin half with tomato sauce and sprinkle with cheese. Top with mushrooms and olives, then drizzle with oil.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups shredded cheese, Italian blend
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to bake until cheese is melted and mushrooms are tender, 5-7 minutes more. Remove from oven.
To serve, transfer pizzas to a serving platter and enjoy!
